provider_formula.anchor: After original71, before subsequent root native requests
provider_formula.delta_p: additional provider/paid allowance consumption since anchor, including actual attempts, failures, diagnostics and UNKNOWN charged by the fixed ledger; not account money inspection
provider_formula.delta_s: new unique valid responses completing the same base source-group requests; never duplicate/historical/failed credit
provider_formula.complete_plan_shortfall: max(0, 35 + delta_p - delta_s + V_remaining + U_remaining + A_remaining)

provider_formula.U_remaining: additional future model requests for changed update inputs not already represented by uncompleted base groups
